title: Additional contents.
bodyText:
A policy may contain additional provisions, which are not inconsistent with this part, and which are:

(1) Required to be inserted by the laws of the insurer's state of domicile; or

(2) Appropriate or necessary to state the rights and obligations of the parties to the contract.

§431:10-216  Additional contents.  A policy may contain additional provisions, which are not inconsistent with this part, and which are:

     (1)  Required to be inserted by the laws of the insurer's state of domicile; or

     (2)  Appropriate or necessary to state the rights and obligations of the parties to the contract. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
